evidence_scope: keyframe self-branch raw pointmaps, and captured fused keyframe pointmaps; non-keyframe evidence is excluded
source_disjoint: no shared original images; unknown ancestry is never disjoint
online_decision: snapshot immediately after KF insertion, before its backend optimization; deferred rechecks only at new KF arrivals
pose_policy: use the snapshot revision at each decision; final-revision hindsight is reported separately
geometry_proxy: nearest valid predicted pointmap ray, positive forward hemisphere, angular support and camera-center parallax; NOT occlusion-certified visibility or ground truth
pilot_progress_rule: all provenance/revision/causality checks pass, at least 3 KFs, and >=10% of sampled candidates have >=1 past source-disjoint ray-supported view with >=1 degree parallax at creation; report >=2-view support separately
progress_rule_scope: operational E0b pilot feasibility criterion, not a research-wide GO, efficacy threshold, or statistical-independence claim
gt_policy: no GT depth or trajectory used in the audit or mapper
timing_policy: input-frame delay, KF-arrival delay, and instrumented wall-clock delay; no assumption of a sensor frame rate
